title: What's Mine is Yours
start: Speak to Doric who is inside his hut just outside the gates of Taverley and north-west of the Falador lodestone.

recommended.t: Activated Falador, Port Sarim, and Varrock lodestones
A weapon and armour for low-level players

steps.t: Talk to Doric in his hut, north of the Falador lodestone, until you get an ore bag and mining sites map. [Chat: 1 Don't worry, I'll help you. › Accept]
Mine any rock in each of the following locations until a living rock brawler appears, kill it, and take the ore it drops:

sub.t: Dwarven mines, to the east up the hill
Rimmington mine, west of Port Sarim

p: The mining sites map, with all 4 locations completed.
A creature of living rock appears!
The dark wizard Elijah enchanting the ore rock.

steps.t: Withdraw the ores from the ore bag. [Chat: 1 Ore.]
Smelt two high-quality bronze bars using the furnace. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Smith a high-quality bronze sword and a high-quality bronze dagger on Doric's anvil.
p: The furnace and the specially designed anvil

steps.t: Talk to Doric. [Chat: 3 I'll leave right away.]
Talk to Aksel in the Artisans' Workshop in south-east Falador. [Chat: 1 Doric sent me here with these weapons.]
Head to the White Knights' Castle and talk to Squire Cerlyn in the west tower on the floor 1.
After the cutscene, help Doric and Boric reconcile. Use the following responses:

sub.t: Boric, tell Doric about your graduation.
Boric, tell Doric what you thought when Doric sent you away.
Boric, tell Doric about your education.
Boric, tell Doric why you wanted to stay here.
Boric, tell Doric what you thought of Keldagrim
Doric, tell Boric what you thought when Boric was born.
Doric, tell Boric why you sent him to Keldagrim.
Doric, tell Boric how you felt bringing Boric up alone.
Doric, tell Boric what you want Boric's future to be.
Doric, tell Boric what you hoped sending him away would teach him.

steps.t: Talk to Doric and agree to take the bars. [Chat: 1 I'd love to. › 1 Yes.]
Smith the items that were asked for on Doric's anvil.
p: A humble gathering for Doric & Son

steps.t: Head down the stairs into Doric's cave (if the "climb down" option on the northern doorway does not appear, try switching textures off temporarily, this is a known bug).
Mine the rocks blocking the way.
Head back upstairs and talk to Doric to give him the items and trigger a cutscene. [Chat: 1 Yes, I have them here.]
